title: Trip Step Added for the Length of a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Reservation
content:
A trip step is added to the young-driver surcharge for how long the guest keeps the car, measured by the
whole months the reserved period of the trip runs for on the Keyturn Trip Booking beneath the Keyturn Guest
Protection Plan election.

1. Where the trip's reserved period runs for 2 or more whole months, a step of 45.00 USD is added.
2. Where it runs for 1 or more whole months but fewer than 2, a step of 25.00 USD is added.
3. Where it runs for fewer than 1 whole month, a step of 0.00 USD is added.

The step is added after the surcharge has been held to its ceiling, and the step itself is not held down by
that ceiling.

## Both sides of the two thresholds

| Whole months the reserved period runs for | Trip step added |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.00 USD |
| 1 | 25.00 USD |
| 2 | 45.00 USD |
| 5 | 45.00 USD |

## Worked on hypothetical reservations

A trip reserved from the third of March to the twentieth of March runs for no whole month and carries no trip
step. A trip reserved from the third of March to the tenth of April runs for one whole month and carries
25.00 USD. A trip reserved from the third of March to the fifth of May runs for two whole months and carries
45.00 USD, and so does a trip reserved from the third of March to the end of August, the step being flat once
the second whole month is reached.
